The Hampshire and the Solent Combined County Authority Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations establish the Hampshire and the Solent Combined County Authority (“the Combined County Authority”) and confer certain functions of local authorities and other public authorities on the Combined County Authority.

title: The Air Navigation (Restriction of Flying) (Coventry, West Midlands) (Emergency) (Revocation) Regulations 2026
The Court Funds (Amendment) Rules 2026
summary: These Rules amend the Court Funds Rules 2011 (S.I. 2011/1734) (“the 2011 Rules”). The 2011 Rules govern the administration and management of funds in court by the Accountant General.

title: The Ministerial and other Salaries Act 1975 (Amendment) Order 2026
summary: This Order changes the annual amount of salaries payable under section 1 of the Ministerial and other Salaries Act 1975 (“the 1975 Act”) to Ministers, Opposition Leaders and Whips and the Commons and Lords Speakers. This Order also updates the formula in section 1A of the 1975 Act that provides for annual alterations of those salaries.

title: The Inspectors of Education, Children’s Services and Skills (No. 2) Order 2026
summary: This Order appoints the persons named in the Schedule as His Majesty’s Inspectors of Education, Children’s Services and Skills.

title: The Criminal Justice (International Co-operation) Act 1990 (Amendment) Order 2026
summary: This Order amends Schedule 2 to the Criminal Justice (International Co-operation) Act 1990 (c. 5) (“the Act”) (which specifies certain substances, useful for the manufacture of controlled drugs, which are controlled under Part 2 of the Act) to add 12 drug precursor chemicals, and 16 associated esters. The amendments reflect the addition of these substances to the Annex to the United Nations Convention against Illicit Traffic in Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances 1988 (also known as the Vienna Convention) under Article 12 of that Convention.

The Financial Services and Markets Act 2023 (Commencement No. 14) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations are the 14th commencement Regulations made under the Financial Services and Markets Act 2023 (c. 29) (“the Act”).

title: The Air Navigation (Restriction of Flying) (Stonehenge) Regulations 2026
The Air Navigation (Restriction of Flying) (King’s Birthday Parade) Regulations 2026
The Successful Legacy Appeals Schemes (Income Tax Exemption) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations provide for an exemption from income tax for payments under the Successful Legacy Appeals Scheme administered by the Department for Work and Pensions in Great Britain and any corresponding scheme administered by the Department for Communities in Northern Ireland (the “Schemes”). The Schemes provide compensation for people who experienced a financial loss when they had to claim universal credit due to a decision to terminate their award of one of the means tested benefits that universal credit replaces, and later had the termination decision reversed.

The Education (Student Support for Postgraduate Provision) (Amendment) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations make amendments to the Education (Postgraduate Master's Degree Loans) Regulations 2016 (S.I. 2016/606) (“the 2016 Regulations”) and the Education (Postgraduate Doctoral Degree Loans and the Education (Student Loans) (Repayment) (Amendment) (No. 2) etc.) Regulations 2018 (S.I. 2018/599) (“the 2018 Regulations”).

title: The Occupational Pension Schemes (Preservation of Benefit) (Amendment) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations amend the Occupational Pension Schemes (Preservation of Benefit) Regulations 1991 (S.I. 1991/167) (“the Preservation Regulations”).

title: The A47 Wansford to Sutton Development Consent (Revocation) Order 2026
summary: This Order revokes the A47 Wansford to Sutton Development Consent Order 2023 (“the DCO”), a development consent order made under the Planning Act 2008. The Secretary of State has made this Order having given notice of her intention to revoke the DCO without an application being made to her pursuant to paragraph 3(1) and (7)(b) of Schedule 6 to the Act.

title: The Dogger Bank South East and West Offshore Wind Farms Order 2026
summary: This Order grants development consent for, and authorises the construction, operation, maintenance and decommissioning of two offshore generating stations located in the North Sea approximately 100km and 122km from the East Riding of Yorkshire coast together with associated development. The Order authorises the compulsory purchase of land and rights in land and the right to use land and to override easements and other rights.

title: The Value Added Tax (Reduced Rate) (Hospitality and Tourism) Order 2026
summary: This Order modifies Schedule 7A to the Value Added Tax Act 1994 (charge at reduced rate) by inserting new Group 17 and new Group 18 to provide for a temporary reduced rate of value added tax for certain supplies of children’s meals for consumption on the premises and certain supplies of rights of admission to shows and other family attractions. The reduced rate has effect in relation to the period beginning with 25th June 2026 and ending with 1st September 2026.

title: The Education (Designated Institutions in Further Education) (No. 2) (Revocation) Order 2026
summary: The Education (Designated Institutions in Further Education) (No. 2) Order 1993 (S.I. 1993/562) (“the 1993 Order”) designated Northern College, Barnsley for the purposes of s28(1) Further and Higher Education Act 1992.
